method.sites: Coal plants of 500 MW or more from the Global Power Plant Database, plus three CPCB critically polluted clusters and Chandrapur's cement belt. Plants closer than ~10 km are one site: the satellite cannot separate them.
method.enhancement: Monthly mean column within 10 km of the site minus the median in a 40–80 km ring (regional background). TROPOMI offline L3, cloud fraction under 0.3. Units: µmol/m².
method.years: Years are compared on January–May only: clear skies and no monsoon washout.
method.status: Check first: SO₂ above background of 150+ µmol/m² over the last 12 months, or rising 25%+ against 2021-2024 (January–May). Watch: 40+ µmol/m². Low: below that, within the noise of a monthly mean.
method.scrubber: SO₂ ÷ NO₂ above background, before vs after a date, minus the same change at exempt plants without scrubbers. A scrubber cuts SO₂ but not NO₂.
method.limits: Columns, not stack concentrations: no verdict on the mg/Nm³ norm. One overpass a day (~13:30), so night releases are missed. Sites a few km apart are merged. Retrieval changes and coal sulphur content also move the numbers, so a change is a reason to inspect, not proof.
